description: Change an event. Only the fields you pass change; moving `start` alone keeps the duration. For recurring events pass `scope`.

alarm_minutes.description: Reminder N minutes before start; null removes reminders.

attendees.description: Email addresses. The server may email invitations.

busy.description: Whether the event blocks time (default: true for timed, false for all-day).

end.description: YYYY-MM-DD for all-day, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (local to the configured timezone unless it has Z/±HH:MM). For all-day events the end date is inclusive.

rrule.description: iCalendar RRULE, e.g. "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE;COUNT=10". null removes recurrence.

scope.description: Required for recurring events: "instance" = only this occurrence, "series" = every occurrence.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD for all-day, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (local to the configured timezone unless it has Z/±HH:MM)

name: update_event
